answer: The marble register is checked at draw time, kernel lists the eligible set, and sonnet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 79 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 79 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 92 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
